reconciliation.policy: Preserve original source records as immutable evidence. Historical assessments have priority 10; existing current assessments retain their higher priorities. No live verification inferred. Raw archive checksums and locations are recorded in linked audit manifests.

policies.sourceValues: originalText stores the unchanged input JSONL record text; CSV stores a JSON object of original cell strings. Full byte-identical input files are checksum-verified in the archive.
policies.deduplication: Only strong procedure/notice identifiers and specific source URLs merge procedures. Every source version and occurrence is preserved.
policies.lots: Explicit lot IDs remain separate. Unidentified descriptions are retained as lot_evidence and are not claimed to identify distinct lots.
policies.values: Decimal strings and currency codes are derived; ambiguous amounts remain unresolved. Values are never summed or converted automatically.
policies.companies: Name-only matches are candidates, not verified legal-entity links. Capability shortlists use traceable company-description and tender-text overlap. Scores are not eligibility or suitability probabilities; uncertain scope and missing deadlines are flagged. Lot matching uses lot-specific text only.
policies.currentStatus: Derived from preserved source records and listed refresh runs. Collection coverage remains partial. Use master/read.cjs with --current to recheck deadline expiry. Individual live verification is not inferred from process success.
policies.publication: Local validated package only. No GitHub push and no removal of source files.
